summary: Preserve iFood's browser-owned authentication, agent-ready private API workflows, concurrency-safe local learning, executable dogfood contracts, fixed dependency floors, and accurate MCP and public documentation across regenerations.
reason: The browser session and anti-bot state must remain private while agents still need deterministic quotation, preview-first cart planning, and optional controlled private-API access. Regeneration must also retain atomic learning reinforcement, runnable validation examples, corrected auth metadata, and security-fixed dependencies so the published CLI stays safe and operational.
validated_outcome: Browser credentials remain unexported; quotation and cart planning stay deterministic and preview-first; private API and MCP contracts agree; concurrent teachers reinforce one learning row without uniqueness failures; executable examples, tests, vet, build, skill verification, and govulncheck pass with fixed dependency versions.
